recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a man in a baseball cap, set against a soft bokeh background, featuring a stacked, heavy-weight sans-serif typographic lockup in the lower right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eyes aligned with the upper third horizontal line
Typography anchored to the bottom right, overlapping the subject's shoulder
Warm sepia-toned color grade unifying the subject and background
High-contrast lighting casting a shadow from the cap brim over the upper face
coreInvariants: Stacked text layout with a horizontal dividing line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but slightly offset to the left, filling approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and the bright, bold typography in the bottom right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes under the cap brim, moves down to the smile, and finishes at the high-contrast text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Occupied by soft-focus foliage and light flares in the upper right and left margins.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans (skin tones, jacket, background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy/black (baseball cap) providing a dark anchor.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tone warmth and high-value highlights in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and cream

characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of a small circular emblem centered on a horizontal rule between text lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales or with a graphic divider.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, vertical, and modern-country aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with light stubble wearing a dark baseball cap, smiling warmly. Use a shallow depth of field with a blurred park background. Apply a warm, sepia-toned film grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, off-white, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in the bottom right corner. Place a thin horizontal line between the two lines of text, interrupted in the center by a small circular icon.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the background
Shadow from the cap brim is present
Overall tone is warm and nostalgic

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face
Check that the grain texture is consistent across text and image
Verify the warm color balance is maintained in the highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Baseball Cap + Shallow Depth of Field + Warm Sepia Grade + Stacked Condensed Sans-Serif Typography.
